sun.swing

类 DefaultLookup

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.swing.DefaultLookup

  • public class DefaultLookup
extends Object
    DefaultLookup provides a way to customize the lookup done by the UIManager. The default implementation of DefaultLookup forwards the call to the UIManager.

    WARNING: While this class is public, it should not be treated as public API and its API may change in incompatable ways between dot dot releases and even patch releases. You should not rely on this class even existing.

    作者:
    Scott Violet
